dedupe_keys.name: transport data gouv fr french national access point for transport data

description: transport.data.gouv.fr is the French National Access Point for open transport data. Its API listed 800 datasets on 26 September 2026: 490 public transit datasets (GTFS, NeTEx and real-time feeds such as GTFS-RT and SIRI), 154 vehicle-sharing datasets (bikes and scooters), 64 carpooling-area datasets including the national base of carpool areas, 38 road datasets, 33 bike datasets, charging stations, pedestrian paths and carpooling lines. The site also offers a national map of GTFS stops, a data exploration map, validators for files and feeds, a GTFS comparison tool, a SIRI query generator and statistics. Its resources are mostly GTFS (565), GTFS-RT (382), GeoJSON, CSV, NeTEx (182), GBFS (177) and SIRI (85), from regional and local publishers. Coverage is France. Access: free, with each dataset under its own licence; most use the Licence Ouverte 2.0 (473) or ODbL (212), and 93 state none. Caveats: quality and freshness vary by publisher, and the site aggregates many producers, not being one dataset. It supports building multimodal network models, service performance and disruption studies and real-time digital twins, and complements the French national road network data and the Mobility Database catalogued here.
